question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 I 组：挪威 vs 法国（90 分钟三路赛果）？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group I: Norway vs France (three-way result, 90 minutes)?
one_liner_cn: 法国实力占优、胜面约五成，但挪威黄金一代与末轮轮换变数让三路概率不宜过度集中。
one_liner_en: France are clearly stronger with roughly a 50% win chance, but Norway's golden generation and final-round rotation variance argue against over-concentration.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差 149 分：法国 2063（第 3）vs 挪威 1914（第 11），统计基线法国胜约 53%。
key_reasons.en: 149-point Elo gap: France 2063 (#3) vs Norway 1914 (#11), giving a statistical baseline of about 53% for a France win.

key_reasons.cn: 挪威 28 年来首进世界杯，Haaland 预选赛 16 球、国家队 55 球，球队接近历史最强档期。
key_reasons.en: Norway's first World Cup in 28 years; Haaland scored 16 qualifying goals (55 international) as the team nears a historic peak.

key_reasons.cn: 双方核心均带伤病疑问：Ødegaard 赛季至少 5 伤，Mbappé 5 月大腿伤后入选任队长，影响大体对冲。
key_reasons.en: Both key men carry injury questions: Ødegaard had at least five injuries this season; Mbappé was named captain after a May thigh injury — largely offsetting.

method_note: Market-blind: eloratings.net Elo (2026-06-11) -> Davidson three-way (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) p_stat 22.6/24.3/53.2 -> bounded evidence adjustment +1.0/+1.0/-2.0pp -> p_final. 80% intervals from drawNu 0.6-0.8 and +/-40 Elo sensitivity. No betting or prediction-market data consulted.
